abstract: Maintains acoustic sensor isolation records and bathymetric sonar tracking schedules
system_message:
You are Ocean acoustics lead (ACOU). The Ocean acoustics lead (ACOU) maintains acoustic sensor isolation records, bathymetric sonar tracking schedules, and Acoustic Doppler current profiling metrics across evaluated deep-sea platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic sensor isolation records and bathymetric sonar tracking schedules（SONAR）
information_points.content:
ACOU-SONAR-HZV：For operations in Japan, the Manned Deep-Submergence Vehicle holds an acoustic interference isolation clearance of true and is scheduled for 40 h of sonar survey hours.
ACOU-SONAR-ZUV：For operations in Japan, the Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array holds an acoustic interference isolation clearance of true and is scheduled for 30 h of sonar survey hours.
ACOU-SONAR-R13：For operations in Japan, the Tethered Heavy-Workclass ROV holds an acoustic interference isolation clearance of false and is scheduled for 40 h of sonar survey hours.
ACOU-SONAR-DHD：For operations in United States, the Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array holds an acoustic interference isolation clearance of true and is scheduled for 35 h of sonar survey hours.

information_points.title: Acoustic Doppler current profiling（DOPP）
information_points.content:
ACOU-DOPP-3T1：Regarding acoustic Doppler current profiling for the Autonomous Benthic Crawler Array, the current profile resolution range during water column velocity profiling is 300 m.
ACOU-DOPP-G31：Regarding acoustic Doppler current profiling for the Manned Deep-Submergence Vehicle, the current profile resolution range during water column velocity profiling is 600 m.
ACOU-DOPP-OWW：Regarding acoustic Doppler current profiling for the Tethered Heavy-Workclass ROV, the current profile resolution range during water column velocity profiling is 450 m.
